title: The lifecycle of a Topocode story
summary: See how authored story data becomes valid source-grounded content, detects source drift, is updated by an author, renders, and joins a static bundle.

sections.title: Draft
sections.body: An author starts with story data that must pass the strict parser before it is valid.

sections.title: Valid
sections.body: Validation resolves every declared source anchor against a stable repository snapshot.

sections.title: Stale
sections.body: The story is rejected as stale when its captured source changes before validation or publication completes.

sections.title: Author updated
sections.body: After validation reports stale evidence, an author updates the affected paths, symbols, or patterns before validating again.

sections.title: Rendered
sections.body: The resolved story renders through the integrity-checked diagram-core boundary.

sections.title: Bundled
sections.body: The generated story joins the catalogue and explorer in the static site bundle.
